newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia plays down spy incident with Sweden.
newsitem.headline: Russia plays down spy incident with Sweden.

text.p: Moscow on Thursday played down the expulsion of two Swedes from Russia earlier this year on allegations of spying and said the incident should not overshadow friendly relations between the two countries.

A Foriegn Ministry spokesman said Russia had decided not to launch legal proceedings against Swedish businessman Hans Peter Nordstrem, detained in St Petersburg in February during what Moscow secret services believed was a spying operation.

"Taking into account the high level of Russo-Swedish relations reached in the recent years, the Russian side deemed it appropriate to limit its reaction to Nordstrem's expulsion," spokesman Mikhail Demurin said.
Demurin made clear a Swedish diplomat also expelled over the incident had not been declared persona non grata in Russia.
"Suffice it to note that in the recent years Russia has not declared a single Swedish diplomat persona non grata," he said.
